profile.name: Shashank Sharma
profile.objective: Full-Stack Developer specializing in the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js). Experienced in designing RESTful APIs, implementing secure authentication, and building responsive, user-focused interfaces. Seeking an entry-level Software Developer position to contribute to production-grade applications and grow within a collaborative engineering team.
profile.educationNote: Based in Agra. BCA graduate from Doon Business School, now pursuing an MCA in Cloud Computing at Manipal University Online.

projects.title: HyperClip
projects.intro: A full-stack video-sharing application covering the journey from upload to playback. A separate Node.js worker uses FFmpeg to generate multiple video resolutions.
features: Video uploads, playback, quality selection, and a creator dashboard built with React and Express.
JWT access and refresh tokens, bcrypt password hashing, and authorization checks for protected actions.
Server-side validation of request fields, file formats, and upload sizes, with centralized error handling.
REST APIs for videos, comments, likes, subscriptions, playlists, and watch history.
Cloudinary media storage and a separate Node.js / FFmpeg worker for multi-resolution video processing.
projects.summary: A complete video workflow: upload, transcode, and watch. Built with an FFmpeg worker, quality selection, and a creator dashboard.

projects.title: CampusVerse
projects.intro: An interactive platform for students to create, discover, and join virtual campuses and collaborative study rooms.
features: JWT authentication, user registration, campus management, and room CRUD operations.
Real-time room messaging and avatar movement synchronization with Socket.io.
REST APIs using Node.js, Express, and MongoDB for users, campuses, rooms, and messages.
Responsive React interfaces with dynamic light and dark themes.
Connected spaces that bring student conversations and collaboration into one shared experience.
projects.summary: A virtual home for student collaboration. Create campuses, join study rooms, and connect through live chat and synchronized avatars.
